visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, slightly wavy brown hair, wearing a thin-strapped yellow and white horizontal striped tank top, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a black marker and carefully draws a cross-like symbol on her forehead while looking directly into the camera. (2) The woman picks up a large, light-beige insulated tumbler with a straw and takes a significant sip, holding the water in her mouth to puff out her cheeks slightly while maintaining a focused look. The background features a minimalist white wall with a large purple amethyst geode on a dark shelf. (3) The scene cuts to her approaching a man with black hair and glasses, wearing large white over-ear headphones and a dark tie-dye t-shirt. She makes a playful, flowing arm gesture toward him while he looks at her with a confused, questioning expression. (4) In a sudden motion, the woman spits a forceful spray of water directly at the man's face; the water is visible as a fine white mist in the air as he flinches and laughs, his face and shirt now visibly wet. (5) Both characters are seen laughing together; the man wipes his face while the woman points at him in triumph, her face full of glee while the symbol remains on her forehead. (6) A title card appears, followed by a shot where the man retaliates by spraying a huge amount of water back onto the woman's face; she is shown completely drenched, eyes squeezed shut and hair soaked, yet still laughing heartily.
